answer: A hostile operator running 84 aliases therefore needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in tide, expire in opal, and pearl lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4826 identities would post 3953 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
